title: Page 348
transc:
Washn
AH Caldwell  May 21st 1865 
Sunday Emily Lady tulip After carrying out the orders for
discharging all summer whose time expires up to Brown of
October willow require venus for Bermuda stanhope If so retain
smutch talbot Dawson pelton shoes deem stomach & discharge there
those entitled to discharge under the orders yard after muster
out all widow welby sent tother states tobey paid off
wiley Belly another shark Weitzel watsons that he has but
allen Compy of Colored pagan new & wishes toothache with
him Benton Cos of regulars now belonging this felton I
have no objection toes doing so please direct him accordingly
US Grant
Lt Gen 


GD Sheldon Ft Monroe  Washn May 21st 1865
Elizabeth Jacob Animal zebra The women & children may
be sent back sligo weaseler Clyde The navy can
take care torch prisoners that were tobey taken blithe
Clyde zodiac Permit no plation by any torch party
with persons out side walrus Infant sour apple tree
